lines: Stop! Don't move! ...Okay. Just checking for wobbles.
I'm Leo. What if the giggly thing comes back? With friends?
Nobody gets ready. So I get ready for EVERYTHING.
Help me pack an emergency kit? Just in case?
Really? Okay! I made a list. Four things.
Water by the fountain. Torch on the Library steps. Blanket in the Cozy Cave. Snacks on the dock.
Then bring them to my bunker, south of the lake.
Okay. I'll keep an eye on the sky.
Water: fountain. Torch: Library. Blanket: Cozy Cave. Snacks: dock.
You got EVERYTHING? Put it on the shelves!
Snacks on top. Snacks hate floods.
D-did you hear that WAIL? It's THE emergency!
{player}: Leo, it's okay. Let's work it out together.

choice.text: Breathe with me. In for four, out for four.
lines: In... two... three... four. Out... two... three... four.
The lake's calm. The Market's busy.
Nothing's on fire. Nothing's flooding.
The Cloud Nest. Soft, warm, quiet.
AWOOOOOOO!
...It's Rook. Howling at the mothership.
My brain shouted EMERGENCY. It was just a dog.
Dad says my brain's alarm goes off for toast.
Being ready is good. But I want fun too.
Zipline with me some time? I'll pack a snack.

rotate: Ready Leo, reporting! The bunker's stocked. Done!
I went on the zipline! Halfway. Next time, all the way.
Now I ask: is it an emergency, or is it Rook?

lines: Is that cloud moving? Oh. They all move.
